verdict.rationale: Aircall's homepage documents a shared inbox where every conversation is visible and teammates can collaborate in real time and step in without losing context. That covers part of the shared-number team collaboration story. Presence appears only as availability data in a developer tutorial for building a custom tracker, which is a building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit shared-number configuration, documented agent presence/availability status, conversation assignment, internal notes/threads, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
